title: 的 / 得 / 地 and Result Complements: 完, 到, 见, 懂, 好 / 难 + verb
description: The three 'de', how well something is done (V得…), finished (完), managed / perceived (到, 见), understood (懂), and easy / hard to do.

points.title: 的 vs 得 vs 地
points.summary: All three sound 'de'. 的 links to a **noun** (my book, the clothes I bought). 得 follows a **verb** to say how well/how much (跑得快). 地 turns an adjective into an **adverb before a verb** (高兴地说).
points.body:
- 我昨天买**的**衣服.
- 他跑**得**很快.
- 她高兴**地**说.

points.title: Verb + 得 + adj: how well
points.summary: Verb + 得 + (很) adj. With an object, repeat the verb: 他说中文**说得**很好 (or 他中文说得很好). Negative: verb + 得 + 不 + adj.
points.body:
- 他说中文说**得很好**.
- 他跑**得不快** — not ~~不跑得快~~.

points.title: Verb + 完: finish
points.summary: 完 (wán) after a verb = finish doing it.
points.body:
- 我做**完**作业了.
- 我看**完**了这本书.

points.title: Verb + 到 / 见: manage to, perceive
points.summary: 到 = reach the goal (找到 find, 买到 manage to buy). 见 = perceive (看见 see, 听见 hear).
points.body:
- 我找**到**钥匙了.
- 你听**见**了吗?

points.title: Verb + 不懂 / 懂: (not) understand
points.summary: 看懂 / 听懂 = understand by reading/listening. Can't: 看**不**懂 / 听**不**懂. 听不见 = can't hear (too quiet), 听不懂 = can't understand.
points.body:
- 老师说得太快，我听**不懂**.
- 这本书我看**不懂**.

points.title: 好 / 难 + verb: easy / hard to …
points.summary: 好 + verb = easy to … / nice to … (好吃, 好写). 难 + verb = hard to … / bad to … (难吃, 难写).
points.body:
- 这个字很**难**写.
- 饺子很**好**吃.
examples: This character is hard to write.

notes: 的 links to a noun, not a verb.
得 comes after a verb, not before one.
这是我昨天买了衣服 isn't grammatical.
得 needs a description of how after it.
questions.translation: These are the clothes I bought yesterday.

questions.explanation: Repeat the verb: **说中文说得很好**.
notes: 得 must follow the verb directly — repeat 说.
The object can't go between 得 and the adjective.

questions.prompt: Which sentence means 'He doesn't run fast'?
notes: 没 isn't used with degree complements.
不 goes after 得, before the adjective.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{已经|yǐjīng}{做|zuò}（　）{作业|zuòyè}{了|le}，{可以|kěyǐ}{出去|chūqù}{玩儿|wánr}{吗|ma}？
questions.translation: I've finished my homework — can I go out and play?

questions.prompt: What does 「{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{完|wán}{了|le}{这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}。」 mean?
{我|wǒ}{找|zhǎo}（　）{我|wǒ}{的|de}{钥匙|yàoshi}{了|le}！{在|zài}{沙发|shāfā}{下面|xiàmiàn}。
questions.translation: I found my keys! They were under the sofa.

notes: 听懂 = 'understood' — the question is whether you heard someone.
questions.translation: Did you hear that? Someone outside is calling you.

notes: 听不见 = 'can't hear' (too quiet) — the problem is speed.
听不完 = 'can't listen to it all'.
questions.translation: The teacher speaks too fast — I can't understand.
This book is in Chinese — I can't understand it.

notes: Twenty strokes don't make it easy.
容 alone isn't used — 容易.
questions.translation: This character is hard to write — it has over twenty strokes.

questions.prompt: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{的|de}{饺子|jiǎozi}{很|hěn}（　）{吃|chī}，{你|nǐ}{一定|yídìng}{要|yào}{试试|shìshi}！
notes: 难吃 = 'tastes bad' — then you wouldn't recommend it.
questions.translation: The dumplings here are delicious — you have to try them!
